claims.claim: 24 speed sports bicycle with hand selector gear controller
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable gear shifter label or a clear count of gears/speeds.

risks.risk: Gear count may not be 24 (could be fewer speeds) or the shifter may be mismatched/defective.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the right/left hand shifter showing the gear markings AND a photo showing the rear cassette/freewheel with the number of sprockets.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a used multi-speed bicycle with unknown gear count; treat as not guaranteed to be 24-speed until proven.

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak, misaligned, or worn (safety-critical).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both brake calipers/lever action plus a short video of braking while stationary.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as needing brake service/adjustment (worst case: brakes not fully reliable).

risks.risk: Wheel/rim condition: bent rim, loose spokes, or tire sidewall damage.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels from the side (showing any wobble) and close-ups of tire tread and sidewalls; ideally a short spin video.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as possibly needing tire/inner tube replacement and/or wheel truing.

risks.risk: Frame condition: cracks, dents, or rust at joints (especially around bottom bracket and seat tube).
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of the bottom bracket area, seat tube, head tube, and weld/joint lines (front and rear).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as used with potential cosmetic wear and possible structural risk not confirmed.

risks.risk: Drivetrain wear: chain stretch, worn cassette/sprockets, or slipping gears.
risks.proof: Photo of chain condition (close-up) and a short video shifting through all gears under load (rider or by holding bike and pedaling).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as needing drivetrain service (chain + possible cassette/sprockets).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the hand shifter(s) showing gear markings and the exact shifter type.
Photo of the rear cassette/freewheel showing the number of sprockets (and ideally a count).
Close-up photos of brakes (front and rear) and a short stationary braking video.
Close-up photos of chain + drivetrain and a short shifting video through all gears.
Close-up photos of frame joints: head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, and rear dropouts.
response.reason: The photo shows a used multi-speed sports bicycle, but the key pricing drivers (exact speed/gear count, drivetrain/brake condition, and frame material proof) are not verifiable from the single image. Request the shifter/cassette close-ups and safety-critical checks before pricing.
